stemMd: A function is given by $f(x)=x^2-4x+7$. What is $f(x+1)-f(x)$ when $x=6$?
explanationMd: The difference simplifies to (x+1)²−4(x+1)+7−(x²−4x+7)=2x−3. At x=6 it is 9. Directly, f(7)=28 and f(6)=19.
